use std::path::Path;
use git2::{Delta};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};


#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct GitYasConflict {
    pub ancestor: String,
    pub ours: String,
    pub theirs: String,
    pub chunks: Vec<ConflictChunk>
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ConflictType {
    Both,           // Both sides modified
    OursOnly,       // Only ours modified
    TheirsOnly,     // Only theirs modified
    Deletion,       // One side deleted, other modified
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ConflictChunk {
    pub conflict_type: ConflictType,
    pub ours_start: usize,
    pub ours_end: usize,
    pub theirs_start: usize,
    pub theirs_end: usize,
    pub ancestor_start: usize,
    pub ancestor_end: usize,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct GitYasDelta {
    pub directory: String,
    pub file_name: String,
    pub change_type: GitYasDeltaChange,
    pub file_path: String,
    pub old_path: String,
    pub new_path: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct GitYasDiff {
    pub old_content: String,
    pub new_content: String,
    pub hunks: Vec<GitYasHunk>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct GitYasHunk {
    pub old_start: u32,
    pub old_lines: u32,
    pub new_start: u32,
    pub new_lines: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub enum GitYasDeltaChange {
    ADDED,
    UNTRACKED,
    COPIED,
    DELETED,
    RENAMED,
    MODIFIED,
    CONFLICTED
}

#[derive(Clone, Deserialize, Serialize)]
pub struct GitYasFileState {
    pub unstaged_files: Vec<GitYasDelta>,
    pub staged_files: Vec<GitYasDelta>,
}

impl TryFrom<Delta> for GitYasDeltaChange{
    type Error = gityas_common::error::Error;
    fn try_from(value: Delta) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        let delta_change = match value {
            Delta::Added => GitYasDeltaChange::ADDED,
            Delta::Copied => GitYasDeltaChange::COPIED,
            Delta::Deleted => GitYasDeltaChange::DELETED,
            Delta::Modified => GitYasDeltaChange::MODIFIED,
            Delta::Renamed => GitYasDeltaChange::RENAMED,
            Delta::Untracked => GitYasDeltaChange::UNTRACKED,
            Delta::Conflicted => GitYasDeltaChange::CONFLICTED,
            v => {
                return Err(gityas_common::error::Error::new(
                    format!("unsupported delta type {:?}", v).as_str(),
                ));
            }
        };

        Ok(delta_change)
    }
}

impl<'a> TryFrom<git2::DiffDelta<'a>> for GitYasDelta {
    type Error = gityas_common::error::Error;

    fn try_from(delta: git2::DiffDelta) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> {
        let old_path = delta.old_file().path().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let new_path = delta.new_file().path().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let file_path = if !new_path.is_empty() { new_path.clone() } else { old_path.clone() };

        let path = Path::new(file_path.as_str());
        let directory = path.parent()
            .map(|p| {
                // Convert the parent path to a string and add trailing '/' if necessary
                let mut dir = p.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                if !dir.is_empty() && !dir.ends_with('/') {
                    dir.push('/');
                }
                dir
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let file_name = path.file_name().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let change_type: GitYasDeltaChange = delta.status().try_into()?;

        Ok(GitYasDelta {
            old_path,
            new_path,
            file_path,
            directory,
            file_name,
            change_type,
        })
    }
}
